title: August and the Inheritance
author: N. M. Ashgrove
blurb: Yara Marchetti, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
